office_hours.text: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00, closed public holidays. The website also lists weekends 09:00–17:00; check with the parish before a weekend visit.

good_to_know.text: All may attend Mass. No standing in Church Hall. Dress with covered shoulders/knees and no hats.
Children’s Liturgy ages 4–10 at third-Saturday 17:30 Mass:17 October,21 November,19 December 2026.

events.title: Feast Day Triduum
events.text: 30 September–2 October 19:30; Fr Bartolo Maria OCD. Themes: humility/love, forgiveness/healing, faithfulness/hope.

events.title: Feast Day Fiesta
events.text: 09:00–14:00; tickets on sale. Feast Day Mass 12:00 celebrated by Cardinal William Goh.

events.title: Children’s Liturgy of the Word
events.text: Ages 4–10 during Mass; subsequent 21 November/19 December.

events.title: Children’s Eucharistic Adoration
events.text: 20:00–21:00 St Teresa Room; registration 19:45, parents welcome. Next 27 November, none in December.

sacraments.text: By appointment; usually last Sunday 12:00 Mass in Main Church except Easter, Feast Day and Christmas. Parent/godparent preparation preceding Sunday 14:00. Submit one month ahead: application, child birth certificate, parents’ Catholic/civil marriage certificates, godparent baptism/confirmation certificates. Late submissions deferred. Godparents must have received Baptism, Eucharist and Confirmation.

Thursday 19:45–21:45 in person; forms at entrances/exits or church office before lift, submit to office or email. Ministry page describes non-Christian adults 22+ and Christians from other denominations; sponsor volunteers welcome.

Saturday 10:00/14:00 only, first-come booking at least one year ahead. Excludes Lent through Holy Saturday, Christmas, obligation days, parish events and public holidays. At least one baptised/confirmed Catholic; agree celebrant before booking and email intent to office.
Contact parish office before confirming funeral arrangements.

ministries.name: Parish ministries and communities
ministries.text: Join via ministry enquiry form: Altar Servers, Choirs, EMHC, Lectors, Media/IT, Hospitality, Catechists/CGS, RCIA, Great Adventure/Bible Sharing, Divine Mercy, English/Chinese Legion of Mary, Holy Souls, Neighbourhood Christian Communities, SSVP, Cafe, CERT, Cantonese Group and First Sunday Fellowship.

other.text: Mass intention requests at least 14 days ahead; minimum$10 per name/Mass/intention. Email requester name/contact, recipient, purpose, preferred date/time and payment proof with bank details blanked out; subject Mass Intention.
